visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black sleeveless tank top and black shorts walks alongside a woman in a black dress under a shop overhang. They are holding hands and talking excitedly. The man smiles broadly at the camera while the woman wears a pink mask and dark round sunglasses. Behind them are parked scooters and closed metal storefront shutters. (2) The man and woman continue walking on the city sidewalk. The man points toward something in the distance. The woman looks in the same direction. They are walking toward a busy intersection with traffic lights and street signs visible in the bright daylight. (3) The man begins running across a pedestrian crosswalk toward a woman in a grey coat. The woman in the grey coat looks back, sees him, and starts running away. They run past a street corner fruit market filled with melons, pomelos, and various red fruits. (4) The woman in the grey coat runs through the glass door of a brightly lit restaurant. The man follows her inside. He taps her on the shoulder. She turns around, laughing and pointing a finger at him. The restaurant interior features warm wood paneling and red accents. (5) The woman in the grey coat is now seated at a hotpot table. She holds a bowl and uses chopsticks to lift a thin slice of raw meat. On the table are multiple pots of bubbling broth in various colors like orange, creamy white, and dark red, along with plates of raw vegetables and mushrooms. (6) A group of five people, including the man and the two women, sit around a long wooden table in the restaurant. They are all eating hotpot, talking, and laughing together in a cheerful atmosphere. Overlays of a cartoon-illustrated calendar appear on the screen.
